how_to_read_this_document.kid_friendly: Read the 'story' field. It explains the pattern like a bedtime story.

notation.ATR(n): Average True Range over n periods
notation.SMA(x, n): Simple Moving Average of x over n periods

universal_formulas.description: Building blocks used by every pattern.

kid_analogy.body: The fat colored part of the candle — like the chocolate in a candy bar.
kid_analogy.wick: The thin line sticking out — like a toothpick through a marshmallow.
kid_analogy.range: From the very top tip to the very bottom tip.

confidence_scoring.formula: confidence = min(wick_ratio / threshold, 1.0) × min(body_ratio / threshold, 1.0) × min(volume_ratio / 1.5, 1.0)

patterns.name: Hammer

kid_friendly.story: Imagine a ball falls down a big hill. Just before hitting the ground, a giant hand swoops in and pushes it back up! That's a Hammer.
kid_friendly.analogy: A hammer hitting the ground and bouncing back up.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A small green or red square with a long tail hanging below it.

patterns.description: Single candle with small body near the top, long lower wick, little to no upper wick, appearing at the bottom of a downtrend.
patterns.psychology: Sellers drove prices down but buyers rejected lower prices and pushed the price back up before close.
patterns.computational_formula: Hammer(i) = (Body(i) ≤ 0.25×Range(i)) AND (LowerWick(i) ≥ 2×Body(i)) AND (UpperWick(i) ≤ 0.1×Range(i)) AND (Range(i) ≥ 0.5×ATR(14)) AND (C(i-1) < C(i-5))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: body = abs(C(i)-O(i)); range = H(i)-L(i); upper = H(i)-max(O(i),C(i)); lower = min(O(i),C(i))-L(i); IF body <= 0.25*range AND lower >= 2*body AND upper <= 0.1*range AND range >= 0.5*ATR(14) AND TrendContext=='Downtrend': RETURN +100

when_to_apply.scenario: After a long fall in price, near support level or RSI below 30.

entry.aggressive: Buy-stop 0.1-0.3% above hammer high
entry.conservative: Enter long when next candle closes above hammer high

patterns.take_profit: Nearest swing high; scale at 1.5-2R multiples
patterns.reliability: High (65.2% winners three days after signal per IJSRED study)
patterns.notes: Longer lower wick = stronger signal. Green hammer stronger than red.

patterns.name: Inverted Hammer

kid_friendly.story: A ball is rolling down. Someone tries to bounce it UP, but it falls back. Even though it fell, the fact someone TRIED means the buyers are waking up!
kid_friendly.analogy: A rocket trying to launch but falling back.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A small square with a long stick pointing UP from the top.

patterns.description: Single candle with small body at bottom, long upper wick, little to no lower wick, after a downtrend.
patterns.psychology: Buyers tried to push prices up but sellers resisted. Yet, the attempt signals buyers are emerging.
patterns.computational_formula: InvertedHammer(i) = (Body(i) ≤ 0.3×Range(i)) AND (UpperWick(i) ≥ 2×Body(i)) AND (LowerWick(i) ≤ 0.1×Range(i)) AND (C(i-1) < C(i-5))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF body<=0.3*range AND upper>=2*body AND lower<=0.1*range AND TrendContext=='Downtrend': RETURN +100

when_to_apply.scenario: End of a downtrend, near support, RSI oversold but starting to rise.

entry.aggressive: Buy-stop 0.1-0.3% above high after confirmation candle
entry.conservative: Wait for a bullish candle closing above inverted hammer high

patterns.reliability: Medium (53-65% win ratio per Quantified Strategies SPY backtest)
patterns.notes: Needs more confirmation than a regular hammer.

patterns.name: Hanging Man

kid_friendly.story: A balloon is floating up, up, up. Then someone tugs on the string — it doesn't fall yet, but everyone gets worried.
kid_friendly.analogy: A climber at the top of a cliff suddenly slips a little.
kid_friendly.looks_like: Same shape as Hammer, but appears at the TOP of an uptrend.

patterns.description: Single candle with small body at top, long lower wick, appearing at the end of an uptrend.
patterns.psychology: Sellers pushed prices down but buyers recovered. The appearance of selling pressure warns of potential reversal.
patterns.computational_formula: HangingMan(i) = (Body(i) ≤ 0.3×Range(i)) AND (LowerWick(i) ≥ 2×Body(i)) AND (UpperWick(i) ≤ 0.1×Range(i)) AND (C(i-1) > C(i-5))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF body<=0.3*range AND lower>=2*body AND upper<=0.1*range AND TrendContext=='Uptrend': RETURN -100

when_to_apply.scenario: After strong uptrend, near resistance, RSI above 70.

entry.aggressive: Sell-stop 0.1-0.3% below low if confirmed with red close
entry.conservative: Wait for next candle to close below hanging man low

patterns.take_profit: Nearest swing low; scale out at 1.5-2R
patterns.reliability: Medium-High (55-60% accuracy per Journal of Technical Analysis)
patterns.notes: Red hanging man is stronger bearish signal.

patterns.name: Shooting Star

kid_friendly.story: A firework shoots up into the sky — beautiful! — but then it fizzles and falls all the way back down.
kid_friendly.analogy: A rocket that runs out of fuel mid-flight.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A small square with a long stick pointing UP, at the top of an uptrend.

patterns.description: Single candle with long upper wick, small body near low, little to no lower wick, after an uptrend.
patterns.psychology: Buyers pushed prices higher but sellers took control and drove price back down.
patterns.computational_formula: ShootingStar(i) = (Body(i) ≤ 0.3×Range(i)) AND (UpperWick(i) ≥ 2×Body(i)) AND (LowerWick(i) ≤ 0.1×Range(i)) AND (C(i-1) > C(i-5))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF body<=0.3*range AND upper>=2*body AND lower<=0.1*range AND TrendContext=='Uptrend': RETURN -100

when_to_apply.scenario: End of uptrend, near resistance, overbought RSI (>70).

entry.aggressive: Sell-stop 0.1-0.3% below low; aggressive shorts if close near low on heavy volume
entry.conservative: Wait for bearish candle or break of shooting star low

patterns.reliability: High (57.1% upside success rate per Liberated Stock Trader)
patterns.notes: Reliable near strong resistance zones.

patterns.name: Doji

kid_friendly.story: Two teams are playing tug-of-war. Nobody wins! The rope stays right in the middle.
kid_friendly.analogy: A seesaw perfectly balanced.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A tiny little dash or plus sign — no real body.

patterns.description: Opening and closing prices virtually equal; very small or nonexistent body.
patterns.psychology: Market indecision. Neither buyers nor sellers gained control.
patterns.computational_formula: Doji(i) = (Body(i) ≤ 0.05×Range(i)) AND (|UpperWick(i)-LowerWick(i)| ≤ 0.2×Range(i))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF body <= 0.05*range AND abs(upper-lower) <= 0.2*range: RETURN 0

when_to_apply.scenario: After strong trend, near support/resistance, before big news.

entry.aggressive: Trade breakout direction of next candle
entry.conservative: Wait for confirmation from RSI and volume

patterns.notes: Doji means 'same thing' in Japanese.

patterns.name: Dragonfly Doji

kid_friendly.story: A dragonfly hovers near the ground — its body is at the top, but its long tail touches the ground. It's telling us, 'The ground is safe! Let's fly up!'
kid_friendly.analogy: A dragonfly resting on the ground, ready to take off.
kid_friendly.looks_like: Like the letter 'T' — a tiny body on top and a long line pointing down.

patterns.description: Doji variant where open, close, and high are at same level, creating a long lower shadow and no upper shadow.
patterns.psychology: Sellers pushed prices down but buyers rejected the lows and pushed prices back to open.
patterns.computational_formula: DragonflyDoji(i) = (Body(i)≤0.05×Range(i)) AND (UpperWick(i)≤0.02×Range(i)) AND (LowerWick(i)≥0.6×Range(i)) AND (C(i-1)<C(i-5))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF body<=0.05*range AND upper<=0.02*range AND lower>=0.6*range AND TrendContext=='Downtrend': RETURN +100

when_to_apply.scenario: Bottom of downtrend, near support level.

entry.aggressive: Enter long when next candle opens above doji close
entry.conservative: Wait for bullish confirmation candle

patterns.notes: Dragonfly Doji at support = strong bullish signal.

patterns.name: Gravestone Doji

kid_friendly.story: A stone standing tall reaches up to the sky, but it has no bottom. Buyers tried to reach the sky, but the ground pulled them back down.
kid_friendly.analogy: A rocket that shoots up but has no fuel.
kid_friendly.looks_like: Like an upside-down 'T' — tiny body at bottom, long line pointing up.

patterns.description: Doji variant where open, close, and low are at same level, creating a long upper shadow and no lower shadow.
patterns.psychology: Buyers pushed prices up but sellers rejected the highs and pushed prices back to open.
patterns.computational_formula: GravestoneDoji(i) = (Body(i)≤0.05×Range(i)) AND (UpperWick(i)≥0.6×Range(i)) AND (LowerWick(i)≤0.02×Range(i)) AND (C(i-1)>C(i-5))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF body<=0.05*range AND upper>=0.6*range AND lower<=0.02*range AND TrendContext=='Uptrend': RETURN -100

when_to_apply.scenario: Top of uptrend, near resistance level.

entry.aggressive: Enter short when next candle opens below doji close
entry.conservative: Wait for bearish confirmation candle

patterns.notes: Gravestone Doji at resistance = strong bearish signal.

patterns.name: Long Legged Doji

kid_friendly.story: Both teams pushed and pulled all day, but nobody won. The rope is right in the middle and everyone is tired.
kid_friendly.analogy: A very long seesaw that went up and down equally.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A tiny body in the middle with two very long wicks.

patterns.description: Doji variant with exceptionally long upper and lower shadows, signifying extreme indecision.
patterns.psychology: Both sides pushed aggressively but neither maintained control.
patterns.computational_formula: LongLeggedDoji(i) = (Body(i)≤0.05×Range(i)) AND (UpperWick(i)≥0.3×Range(i)) AND (LowerWick(i)≥0.3×Range(i))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF body<=0.05*range AND upper>=0.3*range AND lower>=0.3*range: RETURN 0

when_to_apply.scenario: After a strong trend, before a major breakout.

entry.aggressive: Trade breakout direction of next candle
entry.conservative: Wait for clear directional confirmation

patterns.notes: Extreme indecision — a big move often follows.

patterns.name: Bullish Spinning Top

kid_friendly.story: A spinning top wobbles left, wobbles right, but stays in place. Slightly leaning green.
kid_friendly.analogy: A coin spinning on a table — you don't know which side it'll land on.
kid_friendly.looks_like: Small body with two wicks sticking out equally, slightly green.

patterns.description: Small real body with long upper and lower wicks of roughly equal length, with a slight bullish bias.
patterns.psychology: Bulls and bears fought hard but neither won. Market is pausing.
patterns.computational_formula: BullishSpinningTop(i) = (Body(i)≤0.3×Range(i)) AND (UpperWick(i)≥0.25×Range(i)) AND (LowerWick(i)≥0.25×Range(i)) AND (C(i)>O(i))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF body<=0.3*range AND upper>=0.25*range AND lower>=0.25*range AND bullish(i): RETURN 0

when_to_apply.scenario: During a trend as reversal warning, or during consolidation.

entry.aggressive: Trade direction of next candle
entry.conservative: Wait for clear breakout

patterns.notes: Slight bullish bias due to green body.

patterns.name: Bearish Spinning Top

kid_friendly.story: A spinning top wobbles left, wobbles right, but stays in place. Slightly leaning red.
kid_friendly.analogy: A coin spinning on a table — slightly tilted toward red.
kid_friendly.looks_like: Small body with two wicks sticking out equally, slightly red.

patterns.description: Small real body with long upper and lower wicks of roughly equal length, with a slight bearish bias.
patterns.psychology: Bulls and bears fought hard but neither won. Market is pausing.
patterns.computational_formula: BearishSpinningTop(i) = (Body(i)≤0.3×Range(i)) AND (UpperWick(i)≥0.25×Range(i)) AND (LowerWick(i)≥0.25×Range(i)) AND (C(i)<O(i))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF body<=0.3*range AND upper>=0.25*range AND lower>=0.25*range AND bearish(i): RETURN 0

when_to_apply.scenario: During a trend as reversal warning, or during consolidation.

entry.aggressive: Trade direction of next candle
entry.conservative: Wait for clear breakout

patterns.notes: Slight bearish bias due to red body.

patterns.name: High-Wave Candle

kid_friendly.story: A crazy wave goes up and down and up and down — the surfer can't stay on top! Total chaos!
kid_friendly.analogy: A rollercoaster with a tiny car in the middle.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A tiny body with two very long, wild wicks.

patterns.description: Single candle with long shadows and a small real body, reflecting high volatility and indecision.
patterns.psychology: Extreme volatility with no clear direction — a battle with no winner.
patterns.computational_formula: HighWave(i) = (Body(i)≤0.2×Range(i)) AND (UpperWick(i)≥0.3×Range(i)) AND (LowerWick(i)≥0.3×Range(i))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF body<=0.2*range AND upper>=0.3*range AND lower>=0.3*range: RETURN 0

when_to_apply.scenario: During high volatility periods, after news events.

entry.aggressive: Wait for next candle's direction
entry.conservative: Wait for multiple confirmations

patterns.reliability: Low (confirmed only 42% of the time per Bulkowski)
patterns.notes: Indicates maximum uncertainty.

patterns.name: Pin Bar

kid_friendly.story: A pin sticks into the ground — deep! But the balloon on top stays up. The ground couldn't hold it down.
kid_friendly.analogy: A pushpin stuck in a corkboard — the pin goes deep but the top stays out.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A long tail with a small body at one end.

patterns.description: Single-candle pattern with a long tail (at least two-thirds of total range) and a small body, signaling strong price rejection.
patterns.psychology: Strong rejection of a price level — the market tried to go one way but was pushed back hard.
patterns.computational_formula: PinBar(i) = (max(UpperWick(i), LowerWick(i)) ≥ 0.66×Range(i)) AND (Body(i) ≤ 0.3×Range(i))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF max(upper, lower) >= 0.66*range AND body <= 0.3*range: RETURN +100 IF lower is the long wick, -100 IF upper is the long wick

when_to_apply.scenario: At key support/resistance levels, after strong moves.

entry.aggressive: Enter on break of pin bar high (bullish) or low (bearish)
entry.conservative: Wait for confirmation candle

patterns.reliability: High (60-65% success per Al Brooks studies)
patterns.notes: Bullish pin bar has long lower wick; bearish pin bar has long upper wick.

patterns.name: Marubozu

kid_friendly.story: A green or red arrow shoots STRAIGHT UP or DOWN with no wiggles at all — nothing but pure color from bottom to top!
kid_friendly.analogy: A laser beam — no bends, just straight.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A long rectangle with no wicks at all.

patterns.description: Long body with virtually no upper or lower wicks; open equals one extreme and close equals the other.
patterns.psychology: Complete dominance by either buyers (bullish) or sellers (bearish) throughout the session.
patterns.computational_formula: Marubozu(i) = (Body(i)>SMA(Body,5)) AND (UpperWick(i)<0.05×Range(i)) AND (LowerWick(i)<0.05×Range(i)) AND (Body(i)/Range(i)>=0.90)
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF body>SMA(body,5) AND upper<0.05*range AND lower<0.05*range AND body/range>=0.90: RETURN +100 IF bullish, -100 IF bearish

when_to_apply.scenario: During trend or at start of a strong move, near support/resistance.

entry.aggressive: Enter on close of Marubozu
entry.conservative: Wait for next candle to continue direction

patterns.notes: 'Marubozu' is Japanese for 'shaved head'. Bullish = White Marubozu; Bearish = Black Marubozu.

patterns.name: Bullish Engulfing

kid_friendly.story: A little red monster tries to push the ball down. Then a BIG GREEN giant comes and swallows the little monster whole!
kid_friendly.analogy: A small kid getting picked up and hugged by a big friendly giant.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A small red candle, then a bigger green candle that completely covers it.

patterns.description: Small red candle followed by larger green candle that completely engulfs the body of the first candle at the bottom of a downtrend.
patterns.psychology: Sellers controlled day one. Buyers overwhelmed them day two.
patterns.computational_formula: BullishEngulfing(i) = (C(i-1)<O(i-1)) AND (C(i)>O(i)) AND (C(i)>O(i-1)) AND (O(i)<C(i-1)) AND (Body(i)>Body(i-1)×1.3) AND (Close(i-2)<Close(i-6))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF bearish(i-1) AND bullish(i) AND C(i)>O(i-1) AND O(i)<C(i-1) AND body(i)>body(i-1)*1.3 AND TrendContext=='Downtrend': RETURN +100

when_to_apply.scenario: Bottom of downtrend, near support, oversold RSI (<30).

entry.aggressive: Enter long at close of second candle
entry.conservative: Wait for third candle above second candle close

patterns.reliability: High (~65% success rate per University of Michigan study)
patterns.notes: Larger engulfing candle = stronger signal.

patterns.name: Bearish Engulfing

kid_friendly.story: A little green monster tries to push the ball up. Then a BIG RED giant comes and swallows the little monster whole!
kid_friendly.analogy: The green kid gets covered by the red blanket completely.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A small green candle, then a bigger red candle that completely covers it.

patterns.description: Small green candle followed by larger red candle that completely engulfs the body of the first candle at the top of an uptrend.
patterns.psychology: Buyers controlled day one. Sellers overwhelmed them day two.
patterns.computational_formula: BearishEngulfing(i) = (C(i-1)>O(i-1)) AND (C(i)<O(i)) AND (C(i)<O(i-1)) AND (O(i)>C(i-1)) AND (Body(i)>Body(i-1)×1.3) AND (Close(i-2)>Close(i-6))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF bullish(i-1) AND bearish(i) AND C(i)<O(i-1) AND O(i)>C(i-1) AND body(i)>body(i-1)*1.3 AND TrendContext=='Uptrend': RETURN -100

when_to_apply.scenario: Top of uptrend, near resistance, overbought RSI (>70).

entry.aggressive: Enter short at close of second candle
entry.conservative: Wait for third candle below second candle close

patterns.notes: Larger engulfing candle = stronger signal.

patterns.name: Piercing Line

kid_friendly.story: A red candle pushes down. The next green candle opens even LOWER, then whoosh — it jumps up and stabs into the middle of the red candle like a sword!
kid_friendly.analogy: A green sword piercing through the red enemy's shield.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A red candle, then a green candle that starts below but closes halfway up the red one.

patterns.description: Long red candle followed by green candle that opens below the low and closes above the midpoint of the first candle's body.
patterns.psychology: Sellers pushed down at open but buyers stepped in aggressively.
patterns.computational_formula: PiercingLine(i) = (C(i-1)<O(i-1)) AND (C(i)>O(i)) AND (O(i)<L(i-1)) AND (C(i)>(O(i-1)+C(i-1))/2) AND (C(i)<O(i-1)) AND (Body(i-1)>SMA(Body,5))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF bearish(i-1) AND bullish(i) AND O(i)<L(i-1) AND C(i)>(O(i-1)+C(i-1))/2 AND C(i)<O(i-1): RETURN +100

when_to_apply.scenario: Bottom of downtrend, near support level.

entry.aggressive: Enter long at close of second candle
entry.conservative: Wait for confirmation candle above second candle close

patterns.notes: Similar to Bullish Engulfing but second candle does not fully cover the first.

patterns.name: Dark Cloud Cover

kid_friendly.story: A green candle pushes up. The next red candle opens even HIGHER, then swoosh — it falls down and covers the middle of the green candle like a dark cloud!
kid_friendly.analogy: A dark rain cloud rolling in and covering the sunshine halfway.
kid_friendly.looks_like: A green candle, then a red candle that starts above but closes halfway down the green one.

patterns.description: Long green candle followed by red candle that opens above the high and closes below the midpoint of the first candle's body.
patterns.psychology: Buyers pushed higher at open but sellers took control.
patterns.computational_formula: DarkCloudCover(i) = (C(i-1)>O(i-1)) AND (C(i)<O(i)) AND (O(i)>H(i-1)) AND (C(i)<(O(i-1)+C(i-1))/2) AND (C(i)>O(i-1)) AND (Body(i-1)>SMA(Body,5))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF bullish(i-1) AND bearish(i) AND O(i)>H(i-1) AND C(i)<(O(i-1)+C(i-1))/2 AND C(i)>O(i-1): RETURN -100

when_to_apply.scenario: Top of uptrend, near resistance level.

entry.aggressive: Enter short at close of second candle
entry.conservative: Wait for confirmation candle below second candle close

patterns.notes: Inverse of Piercing Line.

patterns.name: Bullish Harami

kid_friendly.story: A big red monster stands tall. Then a tiny green baby appears INSIDE the monster's belly. The baby is growing — the monster is getting weak!
kid_friendly.analogy: A pregnant monster — something new and green is growing inside.
kid_friendly.looks_like: Big red candle, then small green candle completely inside its body.

patterns.description: Long red candle followed by smaller green candle whose body is completely contained within the first candle's body.
patterns.psychology: Large bearish candle shows selling. Small bullish candle indicates selling momentum is weakening.
patterns.computational_formula: BullishHarami(i) = (C(i-1)<O(i-1)) AND (Body(i-1)>SMA(Body,5)) AND (C(i)>O(i)) AND (O(i)>C(i-1)) AND (C(i)<O(i-1)) AND (Body(i)<Body(i-1)×0.5)
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF bearish(i-1) AND body(i-1)>SMA(body,5) AND bullish(i) AND O(i)>C(i-1) AND C(i)<O(i-1) AND body(i)<body(i-1)*0.5: RETURN +100

when_to_apply.scenario: Bottom of downtrend, near support, oversold RSI.

entry.aggressive: Enter long when price breaks above high of second candle
entry.conservative: Wait for bullish confirmation above first candle open

patterns.notes: Smaller second candle = stronger signal. Harami Cross (doji) is stronger.

patterns.name: Bearish Harami

kid_friendly.story: A big green friendly giant stands tall. Then a tiny red baby appears inside. The baby red is growing — the giant is getting weak!
kid_friendly.analogy: A big green balloon with a tiny red one growing inside.
kid_friendly.looks_like: Big green candle, then small red candle completely inside its body.

patterns.description: Long green candle followed by smaller red candle whose body is completely contained within the first candle's body.
patterns.psychology: Large bullish candle shows buying. Small bearish candle indicates buying momentum is weakening.
patterns.computational_formula: BearishHarami(i) = (C(i-1)>O(i-1)) AND (Body(i-1)>SMA(Body,5)) AND (C(i)<O(i)) AND (O(i)<C(i-1)) AND (C(i)>O(i-1)) AND (Body(i)<Body(i-1)×0.5)
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF bullish(i-1) AND body(i-1)>SMA(body,5) AND bearish(i) AND O(i)<C(i-1) AND C(i)>O(i-1) AND body(i)<body(i-1)*0.5: RETURN -100

when_to_apply.scenario: Top of uptrend, near resistance, overbought RSI.

entry.aggressive: Enter short when price breaks below low of second candle
entry.conservative: Wait for bearish confirmation below first candle low

patterns.notes: Harami Cross (doji) is stronger.

patterns.name: Harami Cross (Bullish)

kid_friendly.story: A big red monster stands tall. Then a tiny green PLUS SIGN appears inside. It's perfectly balanced — the monster is about to fall!
kid_friendly.analogy: A perfectly balanced baby inside a monster.
kid_friendly.looks_like: Big red candle, then a doji (plus sign) inside its body.

patterns.description: Long red candle followed by a doji completely contained within the first candle's body.
patterns.psychology: Large bearish candle followed by complete indecision — the downtrend is losing steam.
patterns.computational_formula: BullishHaramiCross(i) = (C(i-1)<O(i-1)) AND (Body(i-1)>SMA(Body,5)) AND (Body(i)≤0.05×Range(i)) AND (O(i)>C(i-1)) AND (C(i)<O(i-1))
patterns.algorithmic_pseudocode: IF bearish(i-1) AND body(i-1)>SMA(body,5) AND doji(i) AND O(i)>C(i-1) AND C(i)<O(i-1): RETURN +100

when_to_apply.scenario: Bottom of downtrend, near support, oversold RSI.

entry.aggressive: Enter long when price breaks above high of doji
entry.conservative: Wait for bullish confirmation candle

patterns.notes: Stronger than regular Bullish Harami due to doji indicating extreme indecision.

patterns.name: Harami Cross (Bearish)

kid_friendly.story: A big green giant stands tall. Then a tiny red PLUS SIGN appears inside. It's perfectly balanced — the giant is about to fall!
kid_friendly.analogy: A perfectly balanced baby inside a giant.
kid_friendly.looks_like: Big green candle, then a doji (plus sign) inside its body.

patterns.description: Long green candle followed by a doji completely contained within the first candle's body.
patterns.psychology: Large bullish candle followed by complete indecision — the uptrend is losing steam.
patterns.computational_formula: BearishHaramiCross(i) = (C(i-1)>O(i-1)) AND (Body(i-1)>SMA(Body,5)) AND (Body(i)≤0.05×Range(i)) AND (O(i)<C(i-1)) AND (C(i)>O(i-1))
